title: RBI Penalty on Muthoot Finance Limited - KYC Violations
description: <cite index="17-1,17-2">Muthoot Finance Limited was fined ₹5.80 lakh for violating RBI's KYC Directions, with the RBI finding that the company did not regularly review the risk categorisation of customer accounts.</cite> <cite index="17-12">The company also failed to implement a strong software system for identifying and reporting suspicious financial transactions.</cite>
